title: Journal of Nigerian Languages and Linguistics: honorifics and humilifics

claims.prefix: A Nigerian linguistics paper on honorifics records that Ete (father) or Mma (mother) may be put before a person's name to show respect, with the examples Ete Mkpang and Mma Effiom.
claims.scope: The paper's data are from Ngwa-Igbo, so native-speaker review is needed before this is treated as Efik usage.
